properties.name: aria-activedescendant
properties.description: Identifies the currently active element when DOM focus is on a composite widget, textbox, group, or application.

properties.name: aria-atomic
properties.description: Indicates whether assistive technologies will present all, or only parts of, the changed region based on the change notifications defined by the aria-relevant attribute.

properties.name: aria-autocomplete
properties.description:
Indicates whether inputting text could trigger display of one or more predictions of the user's intended value for an input and specifies how predictions would be
presented if they are made.

properties.name: aria-braillelabel
properties.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element, which is intended to be converted into Braille.

properties.name: aria-brailleroledescription
properties.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized abbreviated description for the role of an element, which is intended to be converted into Braille.

properties.name: aria-checked
properties.description: Indicates the current "checked" state of checkboxes, radio buttons, and other widgets.

properties.name: aria-colcount
properties.description: Defines the total number of columns in a table, grid, or treegrid.

properties.name: aria-colindex
properties.description: Defines an element's column index or position with respect to the total number of columns within a table, grid, or treegrid.

properties.name: aria-colindextext
properties.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-colindex.

properties.name: aria-colspan
properties.description: Defines the number of columns spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

properties.name: aria-controls
properties.description: Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current element.

properties.name: aria-current
properties.description: Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related elements.

properties.name: aria-describedby
properties.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

properties.name: aria-description
properties.description: Defines a string value that describes or annotates the current element.

properties.name: aria-details
properties.description: Identifies the element that provides a detailed, extended description for the object.

properties.name: aria-disabled
properties.description: Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise operable.

properties.name: aria-dropeffect
properties.description: Indicates what functions can be performed when a dragged object is released on the drop target.

properties.name: aria-errormessage
properties.description: Identifies the element that provides an error message for the object.

properties.name: aria-expanded
properties.description: Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded or collapsed.

properties.name: aria-flowto
properties.description:
Identifies the next element (or elements) in an alternate reading order of content which, at the user's discretion,
allows assistive technology to override the general default of reading in document source order.

properties.name: aria-grabbed
properties.description: Indicates an element's "grabbed" state in a drag-and-drop operation.

properties.name: aria-haspopup
properties.description: Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that can be triggered by an element.

properties.name: aria-hidden
properties.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

properties.name: aria-invalid
properties.description: Indicates the entered value does not conform to the format expected by the application.

properties.name: aria-keyshortcuts
properties.description: Indicates keyboard shortcuts that an author has implemented to activate or give focus to an element.

properties.name: aria-label
properties.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

properties.name: aria-labelledby
properties.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

properties.name: aria-level
properties.description: Defines the hierarchical level of an element within a structure.

properties.name: aria-live
properties.description: Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

properties.name: aria-modal
properties.description: Indicates whether an element is modal when displayed.

properties.name: aria-multiline
properties.description: Indicates whether a text box accepts multiple lines of input or only a single line.

properties.name: aria-multiselectable
properties.description: Indicates that the user may select more than one item from the current selectable descendants.

properties.name: aria-orientation
properties.description: Indicates whether the element's orientation is horizontal, vertical, or unknown/ambiguous.

properties.name: aria-owns
properties.description:
Identifies an element (or elements) in order to define a visual, functional, or contextual parent/child relationship
between DOM elements where the DOM hierarchy cannot be used to represent the relationship.

properties.name: aria-placeholder
properties.description:
Defines a short hint (a word or short phrase) intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value.
A hint could be a sample value or a brief description of the expected format.

properties.name: aria-posinset
properties.description: Defines an element's number or position in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

properties.name: aria-pressed
properties.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

properties.name: aria-readonly
properties.description: Indicates that the element is not editable, but is otherwise operable.

properties.name: container
properties.description:
Renders the popup into this element instead of in place, like a container
inside a shadow root or an iframe. On web components, a CSS selector.
Nested popups stay inside their parent.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the dialog is open. Pass it to control the dialog.

properties.name: defaultOpen
properties.description: Whether the dialog starts open, when uncontrolled. Focus moves into it once it's on the page.

properties.name: onOpenChangeComplete
properties.description: Runs once the dialog has finished opening or closing, after any animation.

properties.name: dismissible
properties.description:
Whether Escape, an outside press and Android's back gesture can close the dialog. Close parts,
triggers and the controller always can. Pass `false` while a form has unsaved changes, and ask
in `onDismissAttempt`.

properties.name: onDismissAttempt
properties.description: Runs when a dismissal was refused, because `dismissible` is false, an outside press doesn't close it, or a Close part's action is running. Ask "Discard changes?" here.

properties.name: persistentElements
properties.description:
Elements that stay usable while the dialog makes the page inert, like a chat launcher or a
password manager's button. Elements, CSS selectors, or a function that returns elements, read
when the dialog opens. Presses on them never close it.

properties.name: pendingAnnouncement
properties.description:
What screen readers hear once a Close part's action has been running for a second, so a slow
action doesn't pass in silence. Set it in the page's language. An empty string says nothing.

properties.name: onOpenChange
properties.description: Runs when the dialog wants to open or close. `details.reason` says why, `details.cancel()` stops it, and `details.returnValue` carries what closed it.

properties.name: onPayloadChange
properties.description:
Runs when the payload the content shows changes: a trigger with another payload opens the
dialog, or takes a non-modal dialog over while it's open, which fires no `onOpenChange`, and so
does a controller's `open({ payload })` on the open dialog. `details.cancel()` keeps the previous payload.

properties.name: modal
properties.description: `true`: the rest of the page is inert and doesn't scroll, focus is trapped, and an outside press only closes the dialog. `"trap-focus"`: traps focus, and leaves the page scrollable and clickable. `false`: a dialog beside the page, which Tab can leave and outside presses don't close.

properties.name: closeOnOutsidePress
properties.description: Whether pressing outside the dialog, like on its backdrop, closes it. The press counts once it's released outside too, so dragging a text selection out of a field doesn't close it.

properties.name: presentation
properties.description: How the dialog presents. `"sheet"` slides it up from the bottom of the screen, where it can be swiped away, and `"auto"` does that on small touch screens. Decided each time it opens; the server renders `"dialog"` for `"auto"`.

properties.description: Whether choosing a suggestion submits, like a search box: `onSubmit` runs, then the form submits.

properties.name: onLoadMore
properties.description: Runs when the highlight or scrolling reaches the last suggestion, so the next page can load, like `createAsyncOptions`'s `loadMore`. Not again for the same suggestions, unless the last load failed.

properties.description: What screen readers hear after typing pauses, when no `AutocompleteStatus` is rendered. Return null for nothing.

properties.description: `false`: the page stays usable while the suggestions are open. `"pointer"`: an outside press only closes them. `true`: also locks scroll and makes the rest of the page inert.

properties.name: presentation
properties.description: How the suggestions present. `"sheet"` slides them up from the bottom of the screen with the field in its header, where they can be swiped away, and `"auto"` does that on small touch screens. A tap that opens a sheet leaves the keyboard closed until the field in the header is tapped. Decided each time they open; the server renders `"popover"` for `"auto"`.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Keeps the field focusable and its text submitted, but stops changes.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Blocks form submission while the field is empty, with the browser's own message.

properties.name: name

properties.name: form

properties.description: The items as data. Renders the list for you, and lets the trigger show labels and find items by typing before the list has ever opened.

properties.description: Items shown instead of `items` while the search field is empty, like recent choices. Groups work, like `{ type: "group", label: "Recent", items }`. Needs `items` and a `SelectInput`.

properties.description: The text in the search field, which filters the list. Pass it to control it. Closing the list empties it.

properties.name: defaultQuery

properties.description: Runs when the search field's text wants to change: typing, or closing the list, which empties it.

properties.name: filter
properties.description: How a `SelectInput` narrows the list: `"contains"`, `"startsWith"`, a function of the item and the text, whose numeric result also sorts data items, or `false` to keep every item, for results a server already filtered.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Whether results are loading or failed, for the status and empty parts. Sets `aria-busy` on the list while loading.

properties.name: onLoadMore
properties.description: Runs when the highlight or scrolling reaches the last item, so the next page can load, like `createAsyncOptions`'s `loadMore`. Not again for the same items, unless the last load failed.

properties.name: announcement
properties.description: What screen readers hear after typing pauses in the search field, when no `SelectStatus` is rendered. Return null for nothing.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: What the value shows while nothing is selected.

properties.name: itemToValue
properties.description: The string an item's value submits as and is identified by, for object values. Strings pass through, and objects use their `value` or `id`.

properties.name: itemToLabel
properties.description: The text a value shows in the trigger, for values whose item isn't rendered, like async results.

properties.name: isItemEqualToValue
properties.description: Whether an item's value is the selected value, for object values that aren't the same object.

properties.name: loop
properties.description: Whether arrow keys wrap from the last item to the first.

properties.name: modal
properties.description: `"pointer"`: an outside press only closes the list. `true`: also locks scroll and makes the rest of the page inert. `false`: outside presses reach what they hit.

properties.name: presentation
properties.description: How the list presents. `"sheet"` slides it up from the bottom of the screen, where it can be swiped away, and `"auto"` does that on small touch screens. Decided each time it opens; the server renders `"popover"` for `"auto"`.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables the select like a native one: it can't be focused or changed, and the value isn't submitted.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Keeps the select focusable and its value submitted, but stops changes.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Blocks form submission until a value is selected, with the browser's own message.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The name the value submits under. Without one, the select submits nothing.

properties.name: form
properties.description: The id of a form to belong to, when the select isn't inside that form.

properties.name: autoComplete
properties.description: A hint for the browser's autofill, like `"country"`.
